capabilities: Render interactive od2-ficha character sheets from YAML code blocks with auto-calculated modifiers, AC, attack bonuses and saves
Roll OD2-specific tests, attacks, initiative and HP with roll-under rules and HP counters that write back to the file
Edit sheets and statblocks through forms that rewrite the underlying YAML
Import public characters from Old Dragon Online into od2-ficha blocks
Generate an SRD reference compendium and export the bestiary as JSON for Fantasy Statblocks
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Fan-made and unofficial; rule content is adapted from the CC BY-SA 4.0 Old Dragon 2 SRD and code is MIT-licensed. Beta versions available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a specific tabletop RPG at the table: no interactive character sheets, no roll-under dice mechanics, and no reference data for a game system.

relations.evidence: cole o link (ou o ID) de uma ficha pública em olddragon.com.br e o plugin baixa o personagem
quando instalado, as rolagens de dano passam por ele
adiciona o personagem/criatura ao combate (nome, PV, CA e modificador de iniciativa)

summary: TTRPG toolkit for Old Dragon 2 that renders interactive YAML character sheets and monster statblocks with system-aware rolls, plus an SRD compendium generator.
